creative_brief.emotional_promise: A tiny observatory moment: one deliberate turn changes a proud ship into a moonlit whale across the room.
creative_brief.format_rationale: A compact double-sided owner card is sufficient for one part and one motion while keeping setup, reveal, reset, troubleshooting, care, and safety together in the box.
creative_brief.physical_format: Two-sided 7 x 5 inch landscape owner card
teaching_arc: Meet the exact object and its two-horizon promise
Confirm the single-piece inventory and age grade
Stand the ship squarely on a level surface
Lift and turn the whole object exactly 90 degrees
Align the apertures to discover the moonlit whale
Troubleshoot the sightline and reset to the ship
Handle, place, clean, and store the object safely
typography: Bitstream Vera Bold for compact display hierarchy
Bitstream Vera Regular for clear instructional text
creative_brief.visual_motif: A crescent observatory mark, deep-night field, and product-derived ship-to-whale sightline make the optical transformation itself the visual system.

findings: The first review showed the final troubleshooting sentence escaping its panel.
The state diagram needed an explicit 90-degree transition cue.
Reset was buried in troubleshooting instead of being independently scannable.
resolved_changes: Reflowed and enlarged the troubleshooting panel so all text remains contained.
Added a high-contrast arrow and vector degree mark between the exact ship and whale views.
Moved reset into its own footer instruction: lift and turn 90 back to the ship face.
